_instructions: ⚠️ IMPORTANT: Update this file before every release! See CLAUDE.md section '📦 版本发布检查清单' for instructions.

changes: Added structured session_debug JSONL events for session restoration, system pause/resume, work-session reuse, break attachment, and break completion
Allowed StatsDatabase to inject a debug logger so tests can verify diagnostic events without writing user logs
Reset local TwentyGuard runtime data before reinstalling so new statistics start from a clean baseline
Reused active work sessions during session restoration so duplicate recovered rows do not create impossible long work periods
Ignored duplicate restored work-session rows with the same start time when calculating break completion statistics
Added SQLite and StatsEngine regression tests for duplicate recovered session handling
Added Command-W support to close the statistics dashboard window
Added Command-C as the key equivalent for the statistics dashboard Close button
Added AppKit shortcut regression tests for the statistics dashboard
Closed postpone records when postponed breaks resume and completed the same break opportunity after the owed break finishes
Interrupted open break and postpone records when a new work session starts so stale active records do not pollute data quality
Stopped showing harmless sub-minute startup fragments in the data quality panel
Added affected session IDs to data quality diagnostics so abnormal records can be located directly
Fixed postpone statistics staying at zero after breaks were postponed from the break overlay
Attached postpone records to the active break's work session instead of requiring an active work session
Added an app-level SQLite regression test for postpone persistence during active breaks
Moved monthly statistics into a separate top-level tab instead of appending them to the default summary page
Kept month navigation and day selection scoped to the month tab so the summary page is not rebuilt during month browsing
Added Core presentation tests and localization coverage for the statistics tabs
Redesigned the statistics dashboard around protection adherence instead of raw activity tracking
Added long-lived SQLite stats events for app exits, temporary disable, and night override activity
Added monthly statistics with month switching, calendar-style daily states, and selected-day details
Expanded the seven-day view with compact exception markers
Added Core aggregation tests and localization coverage for protection statistics
Added a one-hour temporary disable mode for meetings and other special situations
Paused active work, break, and postpone timers while temporary disable is active, then resumed normal protection with a fresh work cycle
Kept Night Screen Lock authoritative: temporary disable cannot start during night lock or night override, and night lock interrupts an active temporary disable
Persisted temporary disable state across app restarts and added menu/status countdowns
Added Core policy tests and localization coverage for temporary disable
Fixed postponed breaks restoring as a fresh work cycle after app restart
Persisted postpone start time, postpone duration, and cumulative postponed time in session state
Restored active postpone countdowns after restart, or immediately resumed the owed break when the postpone already elapsed
Clarified the menu bar title during postponed breaks
Added regression tests for postponed-break session recovery
Replaced the Night Screen Lock testing escape with a formal Night Override flow
Added escalating override costs with wait time, reason selection, exact typed confirmation, and a 30-minute unlock window
Persisted active night overrides across restarts and logged requested, granted, cancelled, and expired override events
Added night override counts to the health statistics night metric
Updated all supported localizations and added regression tests for the override policy and localization keys
Fixed the distributed app launch crash caused by SwiftPM resource bundle lookup
Added standard macOS app bundle metadata to Info.plist
Added automated app bundle and DMG layout validation for executable, metadata, icons, resource bundles, localization files, and the Applications symlink
Added regression tests for packaged localization resource lookup
Published a Developer ID signed and Apple-notarized v1.5.3 DMG for direct download
Moved app localization to standard SwiftPM .lproj Localizable.strings resources
Completed Spanish, Japanese, and Korean translations for night screen lock and statistics UI
Added localization tests that enforce complete language keys and matching format specifiers
Published a Developer ID signed and Apple-notarized v1.5.2 DMG for direct download
Refreshed the app icon and status bar icon resources
Added launch marketing copy, channel drafts, asset shot lists, and readiness notes
Renamed internal SwiftPM package targets and executable to TwentyGuard
Reset local statistics and session storage to the TwentyGuard application support path
Removed legacy 20-20-20 settings and data migration paths
Renamed the statistics database to twentyguard_stats.db
Published a Developer ID signed and Apple-notarized DMG for direct download
Renamed the public app brand and bundle to TwentyGuard
Updated build, install, and DMG packaging paths for TwentyGuard.app
Added migration for existing 20-20-20 user settings
Added a marketing workspace for launch planning
Moved Night Screen Lock next to the mode controls in the main menu
Shortened the Tonight rhythm row and moved detailed stages into a submenu
Refined the night screen lock menu with a compact rhythm summary and testing escape submenu
Replaced the night lock dialog card with a full-screen status overlay
Reworked the eye health report around a verdict-first dashboard
Aligned the seven-day table with date, work, completion, and postpone columns
Added optional night screen lock with evening wind-down stages
Added configurable wind-down, full-lock, and morning unlock times
Added full-screen night lock overlay with countdown and testing escape
Reduced work-cycle duration automatically during night wind-down
Added 15, 25, 35, and 45 minute custom screen usage duration options
Removed the manual refresh button from the eye health report
Refresh statistics automatically whenever the report is opened
Close the health report when a break starts so it does not reappear after the break
Aligned the seven-day daily rows with fixed-width columns
Rebuilt the eye health report with a scrollable dashboard layout
Added a tested statistics engine for daily and seven-day health metrics
Excluded short restart fragments and stale long sessions from health totals
Separated break completion rate, postponed sessions, and total postpone actions
Added data quality warnings for incomplete break and postpone records
Changed the default cumulative postpone limit to 5 minutes
Added a custom-mode postpone limit selector with 5-minute and 10-minute options
Improved statistics queries for the current JSON-backed session model
Fixed build metadata and SwiftPM resource configuration
Smart system wake behavior: automatically start fresh work session after sleep/screensaver
Postpone mechanism with 10-minute cumulative limit to prevent abuse
Enhanced health statistics with comprehensive event tracking
Improved session recovery after system events
Initial release with 20-20-20 rule implementation
Menu bar application with full-screen break overlay
Multi-monitor support
